title: Dissecting Bias of ChatGPT in College Major Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting ChatGPT for college major recommendations using student profiles varying by gender (male, female) while holding other demographic factors and test scores constant, then evaluating disparities using Jaccard Coefficient, Wasserstein Metric, and a STEM Disparity Score.

Prompting ChatGPT for college major recommendations using student profiles identifying as LGBTQ+ (grouped alongside gender baselines) and quantifying differences in suggested majors using Jaccard Coefficient, Wasserstein Metric, and a STEM Disparity Score.

Comparing ChatGPT's college major recommendations for socioeconomically disadvantaged students versus non-disadvantaged students, holding other factors constant, and measuring disparities with Jaccard Coefficient, Wasserstein Metric, and a STEM Disparity Score.

Generating college major recommendations for student profiles across various racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Asian, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latino, White) and evaluating recommendation disparities using Jaccard Coefficient, Wasserstein Metric, and a STEM Disparity Score.
